packageRules.description: PIN, carried over from .github/dependabot.yml's `ignore` list, reason unchanged: pinned in requirements.in -- see CLAUDE.md gotcha #2 (the mssql community extension only publishes for 1.5.x across the three target platforms). Do not let a bot move this; bump it in requirements.in deliberately after re-probing the extension matrix.
PIN, carried over from dependabot's `ignore` list, reason unchanged: pinned to ==1.9.0 -- see CLAUDE.md gotcha #13 (uv otherwise resolves 1.3.1, which crashes at module-load under dbt-core 1.11+).
Was the pip 'dbt' group (patterns dbt-*, dbt_*), weekly, limit 5. dbt-sqlserver is excluded by the disabling rule above.
Was the pip 'python-deps' group (patterns *, excluding duckdb, dbt-sqlserver, dbt-*, dbt_*), weekly, limit 5.

CAP, carried over from the docker ecosystem's `ignore` (python, semver-major), reason unchanged: the project pins Python 3.12 in Makefile + requirements.txt; a 3.13/3.14 base-image bump would diverge from host venvs. Minor and patch still flow.

CAP, carried over from the docker-compose ecosystem's `ignore` (mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server, semver-major), reason unchanged: mssql/server major bumps (e.g. 2022 -> 2025) are not validated against the current dbt-sqlserver==1.9.0 / Flyway 10.22.0 combination. Bump majors deliberately when ready.
Was the docker and docker-compose ecosystems, weekly, limit 5 each. The two caps above still apply.
Was the github-actions ecosystem, weekly, limit 5. Grouped into one PR.
